defects.title: Since you were away shows a task as Completed beside only the steps finished before the return
defects.repro: STANDIN_STEP_MS=1500 (and separately 800). Continue as Ana, send "long task: report check [long]", close the page, reopen 4 s later in the same browser, read Since you were away; leave it open 10-13 s and read it and Task: report check again.
defects.expected: The report's status and its finished steps describe the same moment.
defects.note: The Stillroom products list no steps in the region; their status updates with the task.

defects.title: The "save a token first" alert stays on screen after a token is saved
defects.repro: Fresh DATA_DIR, no PROVIDER_TOKEN. Continue as Maya, type "hello before token" in Message, press Enter; then type sk-local-abcdefghijkl in Provider token and Save token; read alerts at 0.7 s and 3 s.
defects.expected: Once the token is saved the stale instruction is cleared or replaced by a confirmation.
defects.note: On the Stillroom products Send is disabled without a token, so no such alert is raised.
